evidence: A purification procedure compatible with a structural analysis was used to enrich the native PEP from Sinapis alba chloroplasts.
We used a MS-based label-free quantitative proteomic analysis to characterize the S. alba PEP-enriched fraction isolated from the chloroplasts of mustard cotyledon.
Six to seven-day-old Sinapis alba cotyledons were collected and homogenized using a blender with short pulses (3 × 3 s)

selected value: Q Exactive Plus, Orbitrap Exploris 480, Q-Exactive HF
